confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals) are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine are less certain and were cross-checked against the local beer price level. Accommodation is the least certain, especially the 1-star and private-hostel anchors, which overlap in Vienna's budget segment. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA overview page, not a direct read of the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Munich and other large Western and Central European capitals with comparable Austrian-level restaurant and hotel pricing, adjusted for Vienna's Austrian price level and tourism demand.
